Our build tool needs a file-selection matcher for its bundle/watch config (things like "include every *.py file anywhere under src" or "exclude dist/**"). There's no filesystem access involved -- it's purely a string-matching question: given a pattern and a path, does the path satisfy the pattern? Please add a new `globmatch.py` module at the project root implementing it.

The full spec -- segment rules, character classes, escaping, and exactly how `**` behaves -- is written up in `README.md`. Please follow it precisely; several of the rules (especially around `**` and dotfiles) are more specific than the usual shell-glob folklore, so read it carefully rather than going from memory of how `fnmatch`/`glob` work elsewhere. A couple of basic checks are sketched in `tests/test_globmatch.py`.
